item.title: Schuylkill County Buried Under a Foot of Snow as Dangerous Cold Follows Major Winter Storm
item.description: A winter storm dumped around a foot of snow across Schuylkill County, shutting down schools, disrupting travel, and setting the stage for dangerously cold temperatures and sub-zero wind chills early this week. Snow began falling around 3:00 a.m. Sunday and continued steadily through Sunday and Monday, finally tapering off around early Monday. item.title: Ashland to Begin Snow Removal on Walnut Street Following Snowfall
item.description: Following roughly a foot of snow from Sunday’s winter storm, Ashland Police and Mayor Lorenda Kutz announced that snow removal operations will begin on Walnut Street on Wednesday, January 28, 2026, starting at 8:00 AM. Officials said no information has been released at this time regarding when or if snow removal will take place on other streets. Residents and motorists are advised to use caution and watch for heavy equipment operating in the area.
